about: Oil India Limited engages in the exploration, development, and production of crude oil and natural gas in India. It operates through Crude Oil, Natural Gas, LPG, Pipeline Transportation, Renewable Energy, and Others segments. The company owns and operates crude oil trunk pipeline comprising an area of 1,157 kilometers; and drilling rigs and workover rigs.
